You look for the submerged ledge that will lead you from the 
lost valley. Norman watches the skies, concerned by gathering 
clouds.

Roll 1D6: if the result is 1, go to 217; if the result is 2, go to 293; if 
the result is 3, go to 294; if the result is 4, go to 317; if the result is 5, 
go to 370; if the result is 6, go to 371.
